subject: Following up on the parking pass question
text: I wanted to follow up after two days about my earlier message regarding the guest parking passes. To clarify, I am not asking for permanent access. I only need a visitor code for this Thursday, because the repair person is coming to the building during the afternoon window. I assumed the office could email a temporary code the way it did last month, but I realize I may not have explained the timing clearly enough. The issue is not the fee, since I am happy to cover it. What I need is confirmation that the code can be used between two and four, because the contractor may arrive early. If the system requires a name plate on the car, that should not be a problem either. I did check the resident manual, and the part about weekend loading areas was harder to parse than I expected. If the current procedure is different from what I described, just tell me which form to complete and by when. I would rather sort this out before the appointment than leave a car blocking the entrance. Please let me know if you need the repair invoice details as supporting information.
